slides.title: Year 2 Is About Using Evidence
slides.content: In Year 1 you built evidence. In Year 2 you use it for: University applications. Apprenticeships. Placements. Employment. Interviews. Applications require examples, not opinions.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Year 2 Is About Using Evidence'? Select all that apply.
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on Year 2 Is About Using Evidence.

slides.title: The Standard Has Not Changed
slides.content: The same expectations remain: Punctuality. Reliability. Professional communication. Respect. Accountability. The difference is that referees and employers are now paying closer attention.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'The Standard Has Not Changed'? Select all that apply.
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on The Standard Has Not Changed.

slides.title: References Are Now Active
slides.content: Year 2 references are: Being requested. Being written. Being read. Recent behaviour often has the greatest influence on current references.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'References Are Now Active'? Select all that apply.
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on References Are Now Active.

slides.title: Human Skills Become Interview Currency
slides.content: Interview questions often assess: Communication. Teamwork. Reliability. Problem solving. Adaptability. Initiative. Your placement experiences provide valuable evidence for these.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Human Skills Become Interview Currency'? Select all that apply.
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on Human Skills Become Interview Currency.

slides.title: Look for Skill Movement
slides.content: The key Year 2 question is: What has improved since Year 1? Employers and universities want evidence of growth as well as achievement.

exercise.prompt: What is a key message of 'Look for Skill Movement'?
options: It applies only to certain students
The key Year 2 question is: What has improved since Year 1
It is optional and not required
It is only assessed in exams
exercise.explanation: The key Year 2 question is: What has improved since Year 1

slides.title: Evidence Matters More Than Ever
slides.content: Weak application: "I am reliable." Strong application: "I solved a file-access problem during placement and produced guidance for future users." Evidence creates stronger applications and stronger interviews.

exercise.prompt: What is a key message of 'Evidence Matters More Than Ever'?

It applies only to certain students
exercise.explanation: Weak application: "I am reliable." Strong application: "I solved a file-access problem during placement and produced gui

slides.title: Create Application-Ready Strength Statements
slides.content: The recommended structure is: What happened? What you did. What it demonstrates. Strong statements are: Specific. Verifiable. Memorable. Evidence-based.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Create Application-Ready Strength Statements'? Select all that apply.
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on Create Application-Ready Strength Statements.

slides.title: Placement Evidence Is Valuable
slides.content: Year 2 students should prioritise evidence from: Industry placements. Final projects. Professional work. Real clients. Significant responsibilities. This evidence is often stronger than classroom examples.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Placement Evidence Is Valuable'? Select all that apply.
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on Placement Evidence Is Valuable.

slides.title: Independence Matters
slides.content: Professional independence includes: Identifying development priorities. Acting on feedback. Updating Navigate. Seeking support early. Maintaining standards consistently. Asking for help remains a professional skill.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Independence Matters'? Select all that apply.
exercise.explanation: All of these are covered in the section on Independence Matters.

slides.title: Quick Revision Summary
slides.content: Key points to remember: Use evidence from Year 1 and placements Prepare applications and interviews Track how skills have improved Build application-ready statements Use Navigate as a live portfolio Maintain professional standards because references and applications are now active. ,
